subject: Request: evaluation credits for BrokerAI pilot
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@brokerai.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: sales@brokerai.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: evaluation credits for BrokerAI pilot

Hi Jonas,

We just signed up for Redwood via the self-serve flow (BrokerAI / asha@brokerai.com). We're evaluating Redwood for a small pilot where we'll use the embeddings + chat generation pipeline for our underwriting assistant. The initial scope is ~2 weeks with expected usage around 500k input tokens and 2M output tokens total across the pilot.

Use case in one line: turn onboarding docs + historical claims into an LLM-powered assistant for underwriters to surface risky policies. If this pilot looks good, we'll migrate a larger workload (production) in Q1.

We submitted the intake form but wanted to follow up to request a promotional trial credit to get the pilot going. Ideally we could get $1,500–$2,000 in credits or a 30-day trial extension to fully evaluate latency and quality under realistic traffic.

I've attached a brief CSV with our expected sequence length distribution and a sample prompt. Happy to provide additional logs if helpful. Can you advise next steps and an ETA for approval? We're aiming to kick off the pilot the week of Dec 6.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Head of Data Products
BrokerAI

Attachments:
- usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 12 KB)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Asha Patel <asha@brokerai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: evaluation credits for BrokerAI pilot

Hi Asha — thanks for the details and the CSV, that helps. Looping in Marissa (manager) and Grace (onboarding) so we can triage quickly. A couple quick clarifying Qs to size this: 

- Is the 2M output tokens estimate for the full 2-week pilot or per week?
- Do you plan to use streaming generation for the assistant or batch embeddings only?
- Any compliance requirements (data residency/SOC2) we should be aware of for the pilot workspace?

If it's feasible to confirm those, I can fast-track a credit recommendation internally and get back with an ETA. If you need us to start before approvals, we can provision a test sandbox and share an onboarding call slot — but credits will make it easier for you to run realistic load.

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) You confirm the token breakdown (one-line).
2) We propose a credit amount and expiry window.
3) We apply credits and schedule a 30-min enablement + perf-check call.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Jonas — reviewed Asha's intake. 2M output tokens over two weeks aligns with a small evaluation. Approve a $1,500 pilot credit with a 30-day expiry from issuance. Please set credit label DEAL-2026-BROK-47 and note in HubSpot (link below). If BrokerAI converts to paid in Q1, we can discuss additional onboarding credits as part of the ACV conversation.

Operational notes for you / Grace:
- Expiry: 30 days from credit issuance
- Billing portal credit code: BROKAI-DEC26-TRIAL (please apply to account id linked in HubSpot)
- Track usage weekly and flag if consumption >70% within first 7 days so we can recommend a top-up or escalation.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Credit applied: $1,500 (code: BROKAI-DEC26-TRIAL)
Expiry: 30 days from today
Account: BrokerAI / asha@brokerai.com
Receipt: attached (redwood_credit_receipt.pdf)

Next steps:
- I've scheduled a 30-min enablement call with Grace for Dec 7 to walk through best-practice batching/kv caching for your prompt patterns. Please confirm availability (11:00 or 15:00 PST).
- Grace will watch usage for early signs of heavy consumption and recommend a top-up if you hit >70% in the first week.

Onboarding link: https://console.redwood.ai/onboarding/DEAL-2026-BROK-47

Thanks and excited to get you running — ping me if you want the credit applied sooner or need alternate billing arrangements.

Best,
